title: Tahoe Sailing Charters

services.name: Private Motor Yacht Charter
services.desc: Our 36' Motor Yacht is actually a Catamaran with a beautiful fly bridge, perfect for taking in all of Lake Tahoe's wonder and beauty. Complete with all the luxury you would expect on any yacht, the "Tahoe Dreamer" accommodates up to 12 passengers and always includes beverages such as premium beer, wine, prosecco and non-alcoholic drinks. Trip start times are adjustable depending on availability. Please call our office for customized trips. faq.a: Advance purchase is strongly recommended, as cruises tend to sell out well in advance. To maximize your chances of getting the day and time you prefer, please book well in advance. Tickets can be purchased with a Visa, Mastercard or American Express.

quotes.text: Highlight of our weekend! Hands down the best part of our weekend in the Lake Tahoe area!! Signing up for the sunset cruise was done over the phone because there was only 1 spot left and there were 2 of us wanting to go. The young lady who helped register us was super kind as was all the staff on the boat. Captain Tyler and his crew were amazing and it was a real pleasure to sail with them!!

Spent the afternoon of the 4th on a 2 hour sail. Wonderful way to spend an afternoon on the lake. Great crew. Serves beer/wine and did a good job if controlling the partners on the boat. A variety of folks on the boat - families, couples and small group (4). We were able to distance on the boat from others on the trip. Very enjoyable! Personable crew and beautiful views.
Picturesque tour of the lake! I had a blast! It was such a great way to experience the lake in a non touristy way. My wife and I had a great time and met a couple new friends on the boat.
